assign.outcome:
**Nineteen places on this site answer "how is a page arranged". The plan makes four.** Read-only study — nothing outside this dir changed except one name in the day page's `children:`.

![](shot.png)

**[One layout system](/framework/ai/2026-09-06/layout-study/)** — the owner's one screen. **[The plan](/framework/ai/2026-09-06/layout-study/plan/)** — 722 lines: the nineteen-row census with importer counts, every decision in file:line, four slices written for a cold reader.

**What becomes core:** `Layout` and `Section`, both extending `Page` — a layout declares named slots and the width range it is proven at, a section picks one, and **a layout owns no content**.

**The demo decision:** `ext/demo` is it — 202 callers against a runner-up with zero. It already has the viewport with a handle (`stage.js:29`), the path bar (`shell.js:137`) and the toolbar (`stage.js:105`). Two of the owner's five parts do not exist: **a title and a footer**, two lines at `shell.js:69`.

**The first thirty layouts are a port, not a design job:** 18 from `imagine/layouts/system.js:129` (already `id n title intro when rules boxes word config`), 11 from `ext/DesignTool/library/patterns.js` (already measured at four widths), the rest from `styles/layouts/`'s 33 dirs.

**Three findings.** 1 — **`ext/layout` is not dead**: twelve importers, `ext/demo/shell.js:7` among them, which is why every demo can wear a control bar. 2 — there is no missing catalogue, there are **three**, and all three re-list the five surface words by hand. 3 — the demo consolidation was already 90% done and nobody had said so.

**The deny list is three, not a system** (the owner's CSS call, folded in): the width range, contrast, and nesting that breaks a mechanism. Section 4 opens with a table of five worries **CSS already answers** — the measure holds and centres, the three spacing ramps, `16cqi` column units, `auto-fill`, the viewport type clamp. Content scale is written-down guidance, never a checker rule.

**About 2,600 lines to delete against 700 added** — 1,895 of it `ext/Playground`, which has zero importers.

**Left, with reasons.** A CSS trap that bit me is unfiled: `.h4` renders uppercase and letter-spaced in this theme, so `span.c("h4", "core/Layout")` prints CORE/LAYOUT — it belongs in the `css` skill's `improvements.md`, which is outside my write fence. `imagine/sections/sections.js` (524 lines) is not on the deletion list: it is `core/Section`'s prototype and goes only after Section proves head/side/main/aside/notes/foot. The `ai/usage.json` refresh was skipped, also fenced.
